say:1:1610830001:1.text: More two-legs. Hepler said to ignore them.
say:1:1610830001:1.source_cn: 一群外来两脚动物……哼。别去管他们，赫普说了，他们碍不...

say:1:1610830001:1.female: More two-legs. Hepler said to ignore them.

say:3:1610830002:1.text: Can we eat them? I'm hungry.
say:3:1610830002:1.male: Can we eat them? I'm hungry.
say:3:1610830002:1.female: Can we eat them? I'm hungry.

say:4:1610830003:1.text: No. Hepler's pack. Not prey. Go gnaw your bone.
say:4:1610830003:1.source_cn: 不可以，他们是赫普的崽子，不能吃。去啃你的骨头。
say:4:1610830003:1.male: No. Hepler's pack. Not prey. Go gnaw your bone.
say:4:1610830003:1.female: No. Hepler's pack. Not prey. Go gnaw your bone.

say:6:1610830004:1.text: Excuse me, Mr. Wolf? Can you tell us what's happening? Why are you all gathered here?
say:6:1610830004:1.source_cn: 狼先生，请问这附近发生什么事情了？为什么大家聚集在一起？
say:6:1610830004:1.male: Excuse me, Mr. Wolf? Can you tell us what's happening? Why are you all gathered here?
say:6:1610830004:1.female: Excuse me, Mr. Wolf? Can you tell us what's happening? Why are you all gathered here?

say:7:1610830005:1.text: Mr. Wolf? Hah! It's El Jefe, two-legs.
say:7:1610830005:1.male: Mr. Wolf? Hah! It's El Jefe, two-legs.
say:7:1610830005:1.female: Mr. Wolf? Hah! It's El Jefe, two-legs.

say:8:1610830006:1.text: ... Right. El Jefe. What's going on around here?
say:8:1610830006:1.source_cn: ……老大，请问这附近发生了什么事情？
say:8:1610830006:1.male: ... Right. El Jefe. What's going on around here?
say:8:1610830006:1.female: ... Right. El Jefe. What's going on around here?

say:9:1610830007:1.text: Those two-legs down there, <style="highlight">feasting</style>. Took our meadow. Loud as thunder, smells worse. I can't even nap!

say:9:1610830007:1.male: Those two-legs down there, <style="highlight">feasting</style>. Took our meadow. Loud as thunder, smells worse. I can't even nap!
say:9:1610830007:1.female: Those two-legs down there, <style="highlight">feasting</style>. Took our meadow. Loud as thunder, smells worse. I can't even nap!

say:10:1610830008:1.text: El Jefe, what are the humans doing?
say:10:1610830008:1.source_cn: 老大，那些人类在那里做什么呢？
say:10:1610830008:1.male: El Jefe, what are the humans doing?
say:10:1610830008:1.female: El Jefe, what are the humans doing?

say:11:1610830009:1.text: How should I know? They yap and squeak. No real words. Like birds without wings.
say:11:1610830009:1.source_cn: 我怎么知道！那些两脚动物不懂从胸腔深处发出嚎叫声，凑在...

choice_prompt:12:1610830009.text: How should I know? They yap and squeak. No real words. Like birds without wings.
choice_prompt:12:1610830009.source_cn: 我怎么知道！那些两脚动物不懂从胸腔深处发出嚎叫声，凑在一起，叽叽喳喳，不知道在说什么。和我们相比简直是哑巴。

say:15:1610830011:1.text: And keep low. Don't get caught!
